extraMeanings.en: a long pipe used to carry oil, gas, or water over a long distance
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The new pipeline will transport natural gas across three countries.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yeni boru hattı doğal gazı üç ülke boyunca taşıyacak.

extraMeanings.en: a statement made by someone in a law court saying whether they are guilty or not
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The defendant entered a plea of not guilty.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sanık suçsuz olduğuna dair savunma yaptı.

extraMeanings.en: to be balanced or held in a position ready to move
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The cat poised itself to leap onto the wall.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Kedi duvarın üstüne sıçramak için hazır bir şekilde bekledi.

extraMeanings.en: to provide or give a service, help, or duty
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She was thanked for the services she had rendered to the community.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Topluma sunduğu hizmetler için kendisine teşekkür edildi.

extraMeanings.en: to express or perform something in a particular way, or to translate it
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The poem was beautifully rendered into English by the translator.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Şiir çevirmen tarafından İngilizceye güzelce çevrildi.

extraMeanings.en: to force something away or apart, as with magnetic or electric forces
extraMeanings.exampleEn: Two magnets with the same poles repel each other.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Aynı kutuplara sahip iki mıknatıs birbirini iter.

extraMeanings.en: official permission or approval for an action
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The project went ahead without the sanction of the local council.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Proje yerel meclisin onayı olmadan devam etti.

extraMeanings.en: to give official permission or approval for something
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The government refused to sanction the construction of the dam.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Hükümet barajın inşasına izin vermeyi reddetti.

extraMeanings.en: a tool like a deep spoon used for serving food such as ice cream
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She used a scoop to serve the ice cream into bowls.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Dondurmayı kaselere koymak için bir kepçe kullandı.

extraMeanings.en: to pick something up or remove it with a scoop or a scooping movement
extraMeanings.exampleEn: He scooped the flour into the bowl with his hands.

extraMeanings.en: to show that you think something or someone is worthless or ridiculous
extraMeanings.exampleEn: She scorned his offer of help, saying she could manage alone.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Yalnız başa çıkabileceğini söyleyerek onun yardım teklifini küçümsedi.

extraMeanings.en: the act of saving goods or property, or the things that are saved
extraMeanings.exampleEn: The salvage of the sunken ship took several months.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Batık geminin kurtarılması birkaç ay sürdü.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: The archer pulled an arrow from his quiver.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Okçu sadağından bir ok çekip çıkardı.

extraMeanings.exampleEn: The whole deal reeks of corruption.

extraMeanings.en: an area of possibility or a general area of activity
extraMeanings.exampleEn: A cure for the disease is now within the realm of possibility.

extraMeanings.tr: (erkek yüzü için) sert ve çekici hatlara sahip
extraMeanings.en: (of a man's face) having strong, attractive features
extraMeanings.exampleEn: His rugged good looks made him popular with the audience.
extraMeanings.exampleTr: Sert ve çekici görünüşü onu izleyiciler arasında popüler yaptı.
